acquisition method: MS data were acquired in a top10 data-dependent method dynamically choosing the most abundant peptide ions
collision energy: HCD spectra were measured with a resolution of 35 000, AGC target at 3e6, maximum injection time at 240 ms, 28 eV normalized collision energy, and dynamic exclusion set at 25 s.
enrichment method: extracts were desalted using self-packed Stage Tip C18 (IVA Analysentechnik e.K., Meerbusch, Germany) spin columns.
fractionation method: peptides were separated on an EASY nanoLC 1000 UPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) using RPC18 columns
fragmentation method: mass range of 300–3000 m/z for HCD fragmentation.
instrument: The HPLC was coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany) mass spectrometer. Mass spectra were acquired manually using an ultraflex TOF/TOF mass spectrometer (MS)
ionization type: direct tissue profiling of different parts of the nervous system by matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight (MALDI-TOF) MS was used.
labeling: peptides were separated on an EASY nanoLC 1000 UPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) using RPC18 columns
